text:
Maya: Quick public thank you to @Ravi and @Tess for tackling that memory leak on staging at 2am. You two triangulated the orphaned cache and patched it before the demo hit tomorrow. absolute legends :sparkles: :raised_hands:
Ravi: oh wow thanks Maya. wasn't fun but glad we caught it. shoutout to @ops-bot for the alert routing — woke me up gently :zzz: :robot_face:
Tess: team effort. Omar helped trace the heap dump and Jin pulled logs. would not have slept otherwise :coffee:
Omar: tiny humble brag: the heap dump had a single huge JSON being retained by an old cache key. removed the key and memory dropped 60% in ~10s.
Jin: logs below if anyone wants the grep command i used:
```
$ gcp-logs tail --filter "service:api AND level:ERROR" | grep -i oom -B3 -A2
2024-08-21T02:03:12Z ERROR runtime OOM at handler.js:122
2024-08-21T02:03:13Z WARN  cache   evicting key: demo_session_9F3a
```
Maya: that grep saved the day. Also, HR-bot — can you send a micro-kudos token to Ravi and Tess? Small reward, big feels.
HR-bot: Kudos issued: 2 tokens to Ravi, 2 tokens to Tess. Reason: "Late-night memory leak rescue" :tada:
ops-bot: alert routed to oncall: Ravi. Acknowledged by Ravi at 2024-08-21T02:02:57Z. :white_check_mark:
Ravi: also — remote coffee voucher for the duo? I'll send from my team budget. tiny gesture but it helps morale.
Tess: yes please. remote coffee is life. also accepting bagels next time we're in SF :laughing:
Maya: no bagels? we'll do a rotating "sherpa" sticker on the wall for the week. low friction and visible. vote: :heart: for sticker, :coffee: for voucher.
Omar: :heart: on the sticker. my puppy approves.
Jin: :coffee: because caffeine is a health & safety requirement at 2am.
Ravi: :heart: for sticker — future intern will see and ask what a "sherpa" is. cultural artifact secured.
Tess: also adding a 1-liner to monthly kudos doc: "Memory leak sherpas rescued staging and the demo. Extra naps taken."
Maya: perfect. small shoutouts like this make a huge difference. Thanks again team. If anyone wants the heap dump snippet I can paste in a follow-up DM. :sparkles:
